title: Construction-NUWCDIVNPT-Interior Renovations
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER > NUWC DIV NEWPORT
description:
The Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport (NUWCDIVNPT) has a commercial construction requirement for interior facility alterations and renovations. Under this firm-fixed-price completion effort, the contractor shall provide all labor, management, supervision, tools, materials, equipment, transportation, and quality control necessary to perform selective architectural demolition (removal of suspended ceilings, flooring down to concrete slab, interior doors, and select partitions) and complete renovation services—including new interior metal stud partitions with Level 5 gypsum wallboard finishes, acoustical ceiling systems with humidity-resistant tiles, vinyl composition tile (VCT) flooring with vinyl cove base, low/zero-VOC interior painting, heavy-duty interior double doors, and interior window units. The requirement further includes reconfiguring HVAC supply diffusers and return grilles, and providing complete electrical distribution upgrades (including a 45 kVA transformer, disconnect switch, and branch panels) to support baseboard convection heating, dimmable LED troffers, localized occupancy sensors, and emergency egress lighting. All work will be executed within an active, occupied military research facility under USACE EM 385-1-1 safety standards, lead-based paint remediation controls, asbestos containment awareness, and base security access requirements within a 120-calendar-day completion Period of Performance. 

  INSTRUCTIONS TO REQUEST ACCESS TO RESTRICTED DOCUMENTS  

 Bidders must submit an access request through the SAM.gov "Controlled" document access system. To be approved for access, the Contractor must satisfy the following criteria:

In the "Reason for Access" text field, you MUST provide the following details:

	 Company CMMC Unique Identifier (UID) / SPRS Entry ID. 
 

  CYBERSECURITY MANDATE (DFARS 252.204-7019 / NIST SP 800-171)  

 Bidders are strictly cautioned that this project incorporates DFARS 252.204-7019 (Notice of NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements). 

 In accordance with DFARS 252.204-7019, the Contracting Officer is legally prohibited from awarding this contract to any bidder who does not have an active NIST SP 800-171 assessment score posted in SPRS at the time of award evaluation. Bidders are encouraged to ensure their SPRS postings are current (completed within the last 3 years) prior to proposal submission.
